identifier.value: Diabetes Coaching and Integrated Medical Plan

product.name: Diabetes Coaching and Integrated Medical Plan
product.description: An app offering diabetes coaching and a comprehensive medical plan for managing diabetes, aiming to achieve a balanced lifestyle for users within 90 days.

product.name: Comprehensive Diabetes Management
product.description: Support for all types of diabetes including Type 1, Type 2, gestational diabetes, and prediabetes, with personalized health goal setting.

identifier.value: Initial Consultation with a Diabetes Educator

product.name: Initial Consultation with a Diabetes Educator
product.description: Free initial assessment session with a diabetes educator to understand the user's health condition and develop a suitable plan.

product.name: Dietary Regulation without Deprivation
product.description: Guidance on healthy eating without feeling deprived, including how to manage medication and reduce health complications related to diabetes.

product.name: Self-care Education
product.description: Educational sessions on self-care strategies such as choosing healthy foods, exercising, medication management, stress reduction, and dealing with potential illnesses.

product.name: BMI Calculator
product.description: A tool for calculating Body Mass Index (BMI) using a person's height and weight to indicate if they have a healthy weight range.
